options.name: access_token
options.description: The graph access token. You can use M(kembitnl.graph.token) to get an access token.

options.name: debug
options.description: Adds some debug info to the output.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: The graph endpoint requested. Also includes all GET parameters.

options.name: host
options.description: The graph hostname you want to use.

options.name: token_type
options.description: The token type. You can use M(kembitnl.graph.token) to get an access token type.

options.name: version
options.description: The version of the graph API you want to use.
